prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production full-figure 2D topview RPG mounted motorcycle IDLE animation sheet for DARKLIGHT: REQUIEM.
Input image 1 is an identity/model reference: the exact Fabius Réquiem NORMAL adult rider and the approved graphite/black/silver bladed motorcycle in eight directions. In image1 the TOP ROW FOURTH figure is rear-left NW, SECOND ROW FIRST is true back N, SECOND ROW SECOND is rear-right NE. Input image2 is the approved prior mounted idle S/SW/W sheet, reference for the SAME physical rider scale, short natural brown haircut, long-sleeved coat, bike model, grounded wheel support, breathing rhythm and rendering. Both inputs are references only. Draw a NEW sheet for the three missing REAR directions. Do not modify either input sheet or repeat its frontal directions.
Create EXACTLY TWELVE separate COMPLETE rider-plus-motorcycle drawings arranged FOUR COLUMNS x THREE ROWS on a wide transparent PNG sheet (roughly1536x1024). Each complete drawing includes the entire rider AND entire motorcycle together, with both wheels, handlebars, hands, boots, head, hair and coattails wholly inside its own spacious area. Leave at least16px clear transparent margins around each whole figure; no overlaps, grid, text, labels, floor, cast shadow, backdrop or checkerboard pixels.
ROW1 ALL FOUR PHASES: NW, rear-left three-quarter, matching image1 top-row fourth view; motorcycle points diagonally UP-LEFT away from viewer. Head, nape, shoulders, chest, pelvis, knees and bike must agree on rear-left orientation.
ROW2 ALL FOUR PHASES: N true back, matching image1 second-row first view; motorcycle points straight UP away from viewer. Show back of short brown head and nape, rear of coat and back shoulders. NO face, eyes, nose or mouth anywhere in this back row. Never put a frontal face on a rear torso.
ROW3 ALL FOUR PHASES: NE, rear-right three-quarter, matching image1 second-row second view; motorcycle points diagonally UP-RIGHT away from viewer. Preserve asymmetries and correct actual right/left-hand grip; redraw this direction, do not mirror the entire NW figure.
Four separately drawn idle phases in each row: column1 relaxed balanced baseline; column2 gentle inhalation with subtly redrawn shoulder/back/chest expansion and tiny natural seated weight shift; column3 exhalation with coat settling, plus an eye blink ONLY if an eye is genuinely visible in that rear-quarter geometry (in N no eyes ever); column4 relaxed return toward phase1 with subtly different weight/cloth pose. Real drawn motion in torso/cloth, not four duplicates, canvas translation, bobbing, interpolation or image scaling. Keep seated hip position, rider anatomy, head size, motorcycle size, handlebars, wheel ground contacts and lighting stable. No wheel rotation, speed lines, attack, leaning drift, raised wheel or airborne frame: stationary IDLE only.
Preserve Fabius adult identity exactly from references: same head/body ratio, height, mature anatomy, clean warm skin, clearly dark-red iris where geometrically visible, natural short brown layered haircut with EXACT same volume/length/silhouette including nape. No growing hair, no ponytail, no transformation streaks, no white/violet/red hair. Exact Réquiem long BLACK coat with restrained wine lining, LONG BLACK SLEEVES, small physical red studs already in references, silver buckles, black trousers/boots. No skull T-shirt, Rock clothes, bare upper arms, red crystals, huge gauntlets, added sword, helmet, aura or invented accessories. Keep the exact approved black/graphite/silver motorcycle model, side exhaust asymmetry and mechanical details.
Rendering: established crisp game-sprite dark outlines and deliberate pixel clusters, matching the reference closely; no blur, photoreal texture or painterly wash, no new chibi/child proportions, consistent body scale across all12. Genuine transparent alpha background. Full figures remain intact; NEVER assemble anatomical components or transplant heads. Output only the new transparent12-figure rear-idle atlas.
